profile.headline: Backend Python Engineer with Fullstack Experience
profile.summary:
Python generalist with extensive server-side experience in Linux environments

Proficiencies: Python, Django, SQL (Postgresql/MySQL), Linux

positions.title: Trader
positions.description:
Traded stocks and currencies (virtual and fiat) over multiple simultaneous time periods (intra-day, medium-term and long-term). Used various analyses and trading styles to meet objectives.

* Increased value of personal portfolio ~25X over initial 18 month period.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on virtually all aspects of Chegg Tutors (formerly, InstaEDU.) Sample projects included:

   • Building integrations with external APIs as part of post-acquisition transition, including a transactional email system using Adobe Campaign, an external role-based access rights application, and an order fulfillment system.
    • Creating custom admin modules allowing colleagues to manage users and payment processing.
    • Speeding up page load time by refactoring middleware to reduce the number of requests/redirects.
    • Writing a management command to audit the database and model definitions for mismatches and/or inefficiencies as well as generate automated reports.

One of four engineers on the weekly on-call rotation, a team of first responders responsible for 24 hour site monitoring, maintenance, and infrastructure improvements.

positions.title: DevOps Engineer/Consultant
positions.description:
Contract role responsible for quickly absorbing all system architecture and build/deployment knowledge from outgoing engineer within 8 day window. 

* Consolidated knowledge of build/deployment processes.
* Automated portions of staging and deployment using Chef, Bash scripts, Ant, and Jenkins.
* Evaluated existing processes and architecture, and presented recommendations for potential improvements to developers.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Part-time contract role assisting with transition to fully outsourced development team.

* Continued training outsourced development team
* Built and generated data exports and reports
* Various triage, maintenance, and on-demand tasks

positions.title: Senior Development Architect/Engineer
positions.description:
Managed and evolved Pictopia's distributed ecommerce and photo fulfillment systems. Sole back-end engineer. Member of Sr. Management team. Reported directly to Pictopia’s President/Founder. Clients included National Geographic, The Associated Press, The Washington Post, Marvel Comics, Major League Baseball, the National Hockey League, and numerous other media organizations. Small sample of accomplishments, using Python, Django, Perl, XSLT, Bash, and other Linux tools:

* Helped manage, triage, and upgrade over 30 servers responsible for web applications, databases, web servers, caching, customer administrative applications, shipping and fulfilment, statistics and report generation, and other functions.
* Added new features and products for customers’ ecommerce sites.
* Built new reporting tools (both for customer and internal use).
* Expanded administrative tools for internal use in various departments (finance, customer service, sales, and shipping/fulfillment).
* Modified generated barcodes for greater processing efficiency and reduced shipping costs.
* Strategic and tactical business recommendations.
* Numerous other engineering tasks.

positions.title: Python/Django Developer
positions.description:
Initial Python/Django developer tasked with building the prototype web application for an unfunded, early-stage startup. Part-time position in exchange for equity. 

* Built web application with early functionality, using Python/Django, MySQL, and Apache, along with a small amount of HTML, Javascript, and CSS.
* Researched and implemented a multi-purpose, AMQP (Python/RabbitMQ) message queue, designed to integrate the web application with several backend Java applications, process data, and serve supplementary functions.

positions.title: Build/Release Engineer
positions.description:
Deployed new software builds and web application changes to staging servers for testing by QA team. Worked with Lead Engineers and Operations team to develop an automated build system. Reported to Director of Engineering. (Widespread company layoffs in August 2008.)

* Documented and published build and release processes for all company products.
* Researched, designed, and proposed a fully-automated solution to improve transition process.
* Began a phased implementation of the build system, for adoption by developers and QA engineers.

positions.title: Database Administrator
positions.description:
Installed, patched, upgraded, migrated, and managed Oracle databases for a newly created position designed to reduce costs associated with using outside vendors.

* Migrated and upgraded several client databases from shared servers running Oracle 8.1.0.7 to dedicated servers running 10.2.0.3 within short timeline, resulting in significant speed increases for all client websites, and an increase in vendor support.
* Reduced on-demand requests for contracted database administrators, resulting of savings >50%, and increased turnaround time by ~60% per request.

positions.title: Build/Release Engineer
positions.description:
Developed processes, policies, best practices, and Linux command line tools for a newly created build/release engineer position. 

* Directed and communicated with outsourcers, merged outsourced projects into main source code repository, pushed changes to staging servers for testing by QA team, and deployed approved changes to production servers.
* This role lowered client costs by 20% over 13 months, using outsourcers shortened the development to production life-cycle, and core engineers were freed to focus on more specialized tasks.

positions.title: Software/Web Application Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented customized server side solutions for database driven websites.

•	Part of team of 6 engineers that built the Hewlett-Packard (HP) Graphic Arts Portal, which received HP Circle awards the first two years of its existence.
•	Implemented and integrated server-side business logic on all areas of HP’s Designjet Online and Graphic Arts Portal websites, using Python, custom templates, and custom frameworks to dynamically render content customized by 15 vertical markets, over 70 country/language locales, and numerous other data points.
•	Built the HP Large Format Studio Blog, including an administrative interface for managing content.
•	Wrote customized, repeatable and on-demand reports for use in monthly dashboards and strategic assessment.

positions.title: Support Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained, updated, and assisted with troubleshooting for client database driven websites.

* Developed Perl and Unix shell scripts for tasks formerly done manually, in some cases reducing labor by 80%.
